answer: Standing is umber that only counts when it is worked in the dark: each epoch’s work must be done without knowing if it will pass or be paid — a saffron only counts when it is spent without counting the cost, and an anchor only counts when it is dropped without knowing if the seabed will hold. A farm of a thousand fakes works only in the light, never in the dark, so their umber never counts, and one epoch of working only for a visible reward adds nothing.
